patterns.purpose: Explain Pillo in a few seconds and get a parent to create a free family board.
sections: Hero promise with a coded morning board
Three steps: build, next step, celebrate
Routine teasers, plan summary, short FAQ, and closing board CTA
patterns.desktop: Cream canvas, content within 76rem, hero board offset on cla-hero, three raised tiles in a row, then a two-plan summary.
patterns.mobile: Board first, hero objects drop behind it, steps stack with numbered clay chips, and the rail becomes a sheet.
patterns.conversion: Create a free board stays available without motion. Secondary path is See how it works.

patterns.purpose: Help a parent copy a starter routine and see it as a working example board.
sections: Morning, after school, and bedtime cards
Detail board with owners and progress
One tip and the other routines
patterns.desktop: Three cards, then a detail with image and text side by side and a resettable example board.
patterns.mobile: One card per row. The whole card is the link. Detail stacks image, then copy, then the board.
patterns.conversion: Use this routine goes to /start?routine={slug}. Unknown slugs recover to the routine list.

patterns.purpose: Show a believable sign-up and first board without storing anything.
sections: Name, email, board name, starting routine, and agreement
patterns.desktop: Form on the left, cla-empty-board on the right.
patterns.mobile: Single column. Hide the side image below 640px. Keep the demo notice visible.
patterns.conversion: Create my board is a demo submit. Nothing is sent or saved. Errors keep typed values.
